stem.text: Which statement explains why the oxygen dissociation curve for haemoglobin is S-shaped?

A.text: At high oxygen concentrations, oxygen dissociates from the haemoglobin molecule.

B.text: Haemoglobin becomes saturated at low partial pressures of oxygen.

C.text: Oxygenated haemoglobin accepts hydrogen ions from carbonic acid.

D.text: The shape of the haemoglobin molecule changes when oxygen binds to it.
